title: 2020-21 Panini Mosaic 65 Kentavious Caldwell-Pope Los Angeles LA Lakers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2020-21 Panini Mosaic sports trading card features Kentavious Caldwell-Pope of the Los Angeles Lakers. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 65. It is a great addition to any basketball fan's collection, especially those who follow the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is not autographed and is a parallel/variety of the Mosaic series. It is manufactured by Panini and is a must-have for any sports trading card enthusiast. Get your hands on this card today!
